name: NMS4U8
adaptation: Perform greedy non-maximum suppression on all four boxes of one image/class. Each box occupies four unsigned bytes [y0,x0,y1,x1] in the low-to-high order; scores are four signed INT8 lanes. Normalize reversed endpoints by min/max on each axis. Process boxes by descending score, breaking ties by lower original index. There is no score cutoff. Keep a box unless an already kept box has IoU strictly greater than in_threshold/255; equality does NOT suppress. Areas use continuous corner coordinates (width=xmax-xmin, no +1); zero-area boxes and zero intersection never suppress. Compare positive areas exactly as 255*intersection > in_threshold*union, without floating-point division. Return up to four selected original indices in selection order, two bits each in bits [7:0]; zero unused index slots. Bits [10:8] contain count. Finite coordinates, exact rational IoU and packed indices specialize the source NMS operation; arbitrary batches/classes, center/width boxes and float32 rounding at the threshold are outside this task.
